heroHeadline: 'Brave Germany': Berlin and Kyiv Launch €4B Deep-Strike Drone Pact as Coalition Plots July Reform Push
heroSubtitle: Defense Minister Pistorius signed the landmark 'Brave Germany' defense package in Kyiv on May 11 — including joint production of 1,500 km-range deep-strike drones and €4B in arms. Simultaneously, Rheinmetall announced domestic cruise missile production to fill the gap left by Trump's cancelled Tomahawk deployment. On the political front, the CDU-SPD coalition reached a reform roadmap with a July 15 deadline covering pensions, taxes, and healthcare after a six-hour crisis summit. Meanwhile, Germany and the EU unanimously rejected Putin's proposal to use former Chancellor Schröder as a Ukraine peace mediator, with EU chief Kallas calling him effectively 'a Russian lobbyist.' The Forsa May 11 poll showed AfD at 27% to CDU/CSU's 22%, projecting 196 AfD Bundestag seats — the widest lead recorded.
